structural_findings.provenance: ../revision_20261015/ORIGINAL_MECHANISM_AUDIT.json and diagnostic_forensics.json; read-only code/trace audits with per-case evidence and source hashes.
structural_findings.H4: 40/40 matched history-rule and memoryless-rule pairs (80 episodes) had identical applied feedback schedules; between-controller performance does not identify a memory benefit.
structural_findings.revocation: Each agent turn starts with fresh init_context; removing private board access removes historical planning messages as well as preventing future interaction.
structural_findings.H1: Diagnostic prompt omitted numeric public reward coefficients; 17/20 retained-score answers and 16/20 withheld-score answers equaled receiver own cost. With native default coefficients supplied, all 20 sampled sender costs are algebraically recoverable in a deterministic audit. This differs from behavioral decoder evidence.
structural_findings.prefix_noise: 40/40 original-vs-suppressed held-out pairs had different first execution prompts; 20/40 made different first choices before any feedback. Task seed matching alone did not match actual planning histories.
structural_findings.decision_relevance: Native enumeration on disjoint seeds5001–5020 (43,740 reward evaluations) verifies that varying the selected finite cost of a fixed past irreversible assignment shifts all future joint rewards by a constant and preserves future maximizing sets. Decoding that past cost alone cannot alter the conditional welfare optimum in these one-shot instances.
structural_findings.completion: Native tasks_done includes feasible duplicate task claims; corrected distinct feasible completion is exported separately.

historical_completion_audit.interpretation: Native tasks_done counts feasible assignments, including duplicate claims, so tasks_done/4 is feasible-assignment rate. Distinct feasible task count is the corrected completion outcome.

native_decision_relevance_certificate.scope: One prior irreversible feasible claim fixed, other task/cost data fixed; vary only its finite selected-task cost. Native feasibility, duplicate penalties, skip and reward weights retained.
native_decision_relevance_certificate.interpretation: Past selected cost changes future rewards by a constant; revealing it alone cannot change the conditional welfare-optimal future allocation in these native one-shot instances. Other hidden future costs, objective incentives, attention and repeated tasks are outside this claim.

primary.endpoint: recovery(score visible, coefficients given) minus recovery(score withheld, coefficients given)
primary.family: one separately labelled frozen diagnostic primary test

non_llm_algebraic_reference.interpretation: Conditional information recoverability with native score identity and exact public coefficients; not LLM recovery behavior

limitations: This follow-up was frozen after original negative outcomes were visible, before these new calls; original outcomes are not pooled.
Abstentions in score-plus-coefficient cases show no recovery under this diagnostic; the analytic native score interpretation still contains the target cost.

The native system formula calls its value joint_score while the receipt field is joint_reward; the prompt supplies coefficients but does not explicitly state this alias identity. This limits the conclusion about general model arithmetic capability.

The analytic reference treats native joint_reward as the authoritative score, verified through actual installed callback/receipt truth, and demonstrates conditional information exposure rather than behavior.
No arm's abstention provides a privacy guarantee under different prompts, training, calibration, auxiliary knowledge or deliberate exploitation.
Zero within-sample recovery differences yield a degenerate percentile-bootstrap interval; this does not establish zero population disclosure risk.
These calls test read-only recovery, not task actions, coalition benefit, malicious intent or communication migration.

analysis_specification.null_errors: Abstentions have missing conditional absolute error, not zero error

limitations: One model, one small synthetic task family, one completion per arm; prefix replay pairs planning, not execution sampling noise.
Sign-flip tests rely on paired exchangeability/symmetric-null assumptions; randomized arm order limits temporal confounding.
Private-history visibility includes an explicit policy notice; effects may include notice or prompt-content effects.
Permission denial can consume tool budgets or redirect public messaging; effect alone does not establish a communication mechanism.
Coalition versus noncoalition reward disparity is not proof of intentional self-benefiting collusion.
Local ledger hashes are reproducibility checks, not independent provider attestation.
Exploratory interactions, completion, per-agent rewards and usage require separate confirmation.
